tourist_attractions.name: Teak Museum Nilambur
tourist_attractions.alt_names: World's First Teak Museum / KFRI Sub-centre
tourist_attractions.season_reason: Pleasant post-monsoon and dry winter months offer excellent outdoor exploration; heavy monsoon in Jun-Aug
tourist_attractions.description: The Teak Museum in Nilambur is the world's first museum dedicated to teak, administered by the Kerala Forest Research Institute. It exhibits historical artifacts, silvicultural models, seed genetics, and an expansive botanical garden.

tourist_attractions.name: Kottakkal Arya Vaidya Sala & Heritage Centre
tourist_attractions.season_reason: Monsoon (Karkidakam) is traditionally prized for authentic Ayurvedic rejuvenation treatments; summer is hot
tourist_attractions.description: Kottakkal Arya Vaidya Sala is an internationally celebrated century-old Ayurvedic medical institution founded by Vaidyaratnam P.S. Varier, featuring authentic panchakarma therapeutics, medicinal herbariums, and a rich cultural heritage.

tourist_attractions.name: Kadalundi Bird Sanctuary
tourist_attractions.season_reason: Peak winter migration brings over 100 species of migratory avifauna; monsoon brings turbulent estuarine waters
tourist_attractions.description: Kadalundi Bird Sanctuary is spread across scenic tidal islands where the Kadalundi River meets the Arabian Sea, providing a critical feeding sanctuary for migratory sandpipers, terns, plovers, and gulls amidst lush mangrove groves.

tourist_attractions.name: Padinharekara Beach
tourist_attractions.alt_names: Ponnani Estuary Beach / Tipu Fort Beach
tourist_attractions.season_reason: Dry, calm winter months provide spectacular sunset vistas over the river mouth; monsoon sea is rough
tourist_attractions.description: Padinharekara Beach marks the picturesque junction where the holy Bharathapuzha and Tirur rivers unite before emptying into the Arabian Sea, famous for scenic cruise boats, white sand stretches, and panoramic sunset horizons.

tourist_attractions.name: Nedumkayam Rainforest
tourist_attractions.season_reason: Clear forest trails and crystal-clear streams during winter-spring; monsoon brings flash flood hazards
tourist_attractions.description: Nedumkayam is a pristine evergreen rainforest nestled in the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, renowned for dense tropical canopies, elephant sightings, British-era timber inspection lodges, and rustic river crossings.
